title: Brake Inspection Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Brake Inspection And Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Brake Inspection Estimate Worksheet covers brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification. The brake service advisor records Brake Inspection And Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Brake Inspection Estimate Worksheet keeps Brake Inspection And Service exceptions visible until the brake service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Brake Inspection Estimate Worksheet at service bay, lift, wheel positions, controlled test area, and customer handoff. Document brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification identity before Brake Inspection And Service begins. Compare brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification findings with stated Brake Inspection And Service criteria; route unresolved Brake Inspection And Service issues to qualified brake-system reviewer. For Brake Inspection Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Brake Inspection And Service. Ask qualified brake-system reviewer to review Brake Inspection And Service conditions beyond the brake service advisor's role.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when braking capacity, hydraulic integrity, component condition, authorization, or safe verification remains unresolved. Protect brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification; document the Brake Inspection And Service notification and await qualified brake-system reviewer direction.
